title: Fatal Fury City of the Wolves Game Adds Fatal Fury: The Motion Picture's Laocorn on November 19
content:
SNK announced on Thursday that its Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves fighting game will add the Season Pass 3 DLC character Laocorn Gaudeamus from the Fatal Fury: The Motion Picture anime film on November 19. The company streamed a trailer for Laocorn as well as a digest movie about the 1994 anime film:

Season 3 launched on July 23 with six characters joining the roster. Rick Strowd joined the game on July 23. Duck King launched on August 27. Kim Kaphwan joined the game's roster on September 24. Manjiro "Mikey" Sano and Ken "Draken" Ryuguji from the Tokyo Revengers anime joined the game as Season 3 DLC characters on October 22. The game will add Reina in December.

The game's crossover with Street Fighter includes characters Ken and Chun-Li. Both characters are a part of the game's Season Pass 1. The game launched Andy Bogard as a playable character in June 2025, added Ken as a playable character in August 2025, introduced Joe Higashi as a playable character in October 2025, debuted Chun-Li in November 2025, and launched MR. BIG in December 2025.

Kim Jae Hoon, the first DLC character for the game's Season Pass 2, launched on January 22. Nightmare Geese launched on February 26, and Blue Mary debuted on March 26. Wolfgang Krauser debuted in the game on April 24, coinciding with the game's first anniversary. DLC character Mr. Karate launched on May 27. Kenshiro from Fist of the North Star debuted in the game on June 28.

The game added real-life DJ Salvatore Ganacci, professional soccer player Cristiano Ronaldo, and Hokutomaru. Other returning characters include Terry Bogard, Rock Howard, Tizoc, Hotaru Futaba, Marco Rodrigues, B. Jenet, Kevin Rian, Billy Kane, Mai Shiranui, Kim Dong Hwan, and Gato. The game also includes the new characters Preecha and Vox Reaper.
author: ANN

title: Shin Oishinbo TV Anime Casts Kenji Yamauchi, Ken Uo
content:
The official website for Shin Oishinbo (New Oishinbo ), the new television anime series of storywriter Tetsu Kariya and artist Akira Hanasaki 's Oishinbo manga, revealed two new cast members on Thursday:

• Yōhei Azakami as Shirō Yamaoka

• Hitomi Sasaki as Yūko Kurita

• Akio Ōtsuka as Yūzan Kaibara

• Tōru Furusawa as Hideo Tanimura

• Kōsuke Echigoya as Tomio Tomii

• Nobuo Tobita as Taizō

• Hiroshi Naka as Kyōichi Koizumi

• Kyō Yaoya as Kinue Arakawa

• Hiroko Ushida as Noriko Mitani

Ken'ichi Nishida ( Good Bye, Dragon Life , Papuwa , Poka Poka Mori no Rascal ) is directing the anime at Synergy SP and Vega Entertainment . Takahiro Nagano ( Reincarnated as a Sword two seasons, Plannosaurus Gachi Koseibutsu Bu ) is in charge of series scripts, and Nozomi Kawashige ( Good Bye, Dragon Life ) is designing the characters. Shinei Animation is in charge of production.

Yui Makino will perform the opening theme song "PROMISE ME," and the band Skoop on Somebody will perform the ending theme song "Akashi" (Proof).

The duo originally launched the manga in 1983. Shogakukan published the 111th compiled book volume in December 2014. The manga has been on hiatus since 2014. Viz Media has published five volumes of Oishinbo on its VizManga.com digital manga service and Viz Manga App, and has also published the volumes in print.

The manga depicts the "fierce food showdown" between the newspaper Tōzai Shimbun's "Ultimate Menu" and gourmand Yuzan Kaibara's "Supreme Menu."

A previous television anime adaptation from Shinei Animation aired for 136 episodes from 1988 to 1992. The anime also includes two additional specials. The manga has also inspired several live-action series and a live-action film.

title: Kakao Piccoma Launches New 'Lulumiru' BL Webtoon Platform
content:
The service is available on web browsers on smartphones, tablets, and PCs. Membership is free and readers can purchase works chapter by chapter. Lulumiru hosts both new series and older series that have had lasting popularity.

The service also has a search function that lets users omit certain characteristics and tags that they do not like, and also a "top x bottom" search function that allows users to choose certain characteristics they want to see in each member of a romantic pairing.

Kakao Piccoma is hosting large-scale advertisements for the new service in Ikebukuro in Tokyo from November 9 through November 22.

Kakao Piccoma currently operates the Piccoma service in Japan, which offers webtoons, web manga, and web novels.

The new Lulumiru service launches less than two months since Kakao Entertainment announced in late September it would shut down its North American webtoon platform Tapas , marking the end a major part of its direct platform strategy in the region five years after investing about 1.1 trillion won (about US$780 million) to acquire Tapas and webnovel platform Radish.

Tapas will end its service on March 31, 2027.

In South Korea, Kakao Entertainment plans to consolidate its two webtoon platforms, Kakao Page and Kakao Webtoon, into a single platform centered on Kakao Page by the end of the year. The company plans to bring together the platforms' content, user data and about 16,000 original IPs.

title: Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United Game Announces New, Earlier February 4 Release Date
content:
The staff for Square Enix 's Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United , a remake of the 1995 Romancing SaGa 3 game, announced on Thursday that the game's release has been moved to February 4 (February 5 for Steam ), over a week earlier than its original February 16 launch. The game's Digital Deluxe version will also have an early access release on February 1 (February 2 for Steam ). The game's staff noted that with the change of release date, those who pre-ordered the game's digital version for Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 will have their orders canceled, and would need to place a new order. The game's producer Shinichi Tatsuke stated the game's new release date and pre-order details in an announcement video. The below video has no English subtitles, but announcement details are in English in the video description box:

The game will release for Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam . The remake features 3D graphics, refined gameplay, newly arranged music, and voice acting. The game features eight protagonists (Mikhail, Monika, Katarina, Khalid, Julian, Thomas, Sarah, Ellen), 20 recruitable companions, and the "Glimmer" system for acquiring new abilities.

Square Enix describes the story:

Set in a world caught in a devastating cosmic cycle known as the Rise of Morastrum, which occurs once every 300 years and claims the life of everyone born that year except a single survivor known as the Child of Destiny, players will choose between eight heroes bound by fate. A little over a dozen years after the last disaster, the Four Sinistrals have returned, seeking to reopen the Abyss Gates and bring ruin to the world. On their journey to save the world, players can choose which lands to visit, which stories to pursue and the order in which to confront the Sinistrals, ensuring a unique adventure with every playthrough.

Romancing SaGa 3 debuted for Super Famicom in 1995. The remastered version of the game launched for PlayStation 4, PlayStation Vita, Switch, Xbox One, PC, iOS, and Android in November 2019.

The Romancing SaGa 2: Revenge of the Seven HD remake game launched digitally for Switch, PS5, PlayStation 4, and PC via Steam , as well as physically for Switch and PS5, in October 2024. The game got a Switch 2 Edition in August 2025.

Square released the first Romancing SaGa game in 1992 for the Super Famicom (SNES) game console. An enhanced remake of the game for the PlayStation 2 titled Romancing SaGa: Minstrel Song launched in Japan and North America in 2005. A ported version of the original Super Famicom game launched for mobile phones and digitally for Nintendo Wii in 2009. The Romancing SaGa 2 sequel game launched for Super Famicom in 1993. The remastered version of the game launched for PS4, PS Vita, Switch, Xbox One, and PC worldwide in December 2017.

title: Supporting Cast Pair for 'Shin Oishinbo' Announced
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Tetsu Kariya 's Oishinbo manga, titled Shin Oishinbo , announced a supporting pair of cast on Thursday. The anime is scheduled to premiere in 2027.

Voice actors Kenji Yamauchi ( Toujima Tanzaburou wa Kamen Rider ni Naritai ) and Ken Uo ( Nazotoki wa Dinner no Ato de ) are joining the anime as Mantarou Kyougoku and Toujin Touyama, respectively.

Kenichi Nishida ( Sayounara Ryuusei, Konnichiwa Jinsei ) is directing the anime at SynergySP and Vega Entertainment . Takahiro Nagano ( Tensei shitara Ken deshita ) is handling the series composition, while Nozomi Kawashige ( Deatte 5-byou de Battle ) is designing the characters.

Kariya began writing Oishinbo in Shogakukan's Big Comic Spirits magazine in 1983, featuring art by Akira Hanasaki . Shogakukan published the 111th and latest volume in December 2014. The manga has been on hiatus since May 2014.

VIZ Media licensed the manga in English and published seven themed compilation volumes under its VIZ Signature imprint from January 2009 to January 2010.

Shin-Ei Animation produced a television anime based on the manga that ran for 136 episodes from October 1988 to March 1992.

title: Nabe ni Tama wo Ukenagara TV Anime Reveals Main Cast, Staff, January Debut
content:
The official website for the television anime of writer Juntarō Aoki and artist Shin Moriyama 's Nabe ni Tama wo Ukenagara ( Getting Shots on a Frying Pan or Nabetama for short) manga opened on Thursday and revealed the anime's teaser promotional video, main cast, main staff members, and January debut.

Shū Uchida and Masaaki Mizunaka will be the female and male voice of the character Juntarō.

Masahiro Hiraoka ( Magilumiere Magical Girls Inc. ) is directing the anime at J.C.STAFF . Susumu Yamakawa ( Back Street Girls: Gokudols , Wound & Bandage ) is in charge of series scripts, Natsuki Ōyama ( Wound & Bandage , Can a Boy-Girl Friendship Survive? ) is designing the characters and is also the chief animation director, Yoshihide Otomo ( INU-OH film) is composing the music, and Yoshikazu Iwanami ( Ajin , Gamera -Rebirth- , JoJo's Bizarre Adventure ) is the sound director.

The manga launched on Kadokawa 's Comic Newtype web manga magazine in 2021. Kadokawa published the manga's first compiled book volume in January 2022, and the fifth volume in October 2024. The manga was included in the top 20 list of manga for male readers in the 2023 edition of Takarajimasha 's Kono Manga ga Sugoi! (This Manga Is Amazing!) guidebook.

title: Live-Action Wandance Film's New Video Previews Insert Song by mabanua
content:
The official website for the live-action film of Coffee 's Wandance manga began streaming a new video featuring the insert song "Step by Step feat. Sagiri Sól , Kenya Fujita " by mabanua , on Thursday.

Kodansha USA Publishing releases the manga and describes the story:

A boy named Kaboku sees a girl named Wanda dance, and suddenly burns with a need to join in. With its thrilling scenes of Japanese hip-hop dance and quirky, charming characters, this is a new, inspirational manga for fans of coming-of-age stories like Blue Period and Your Lie in April . Get up and join the Wandance ! Kaboku has always just gone with the flow, marching in step to the drumbeat of the expectations of those around him: parents, school, plans for the future. It feels predictable, safe, and... empty. But one night, Kaboku's at school late, and he happens on a girl alone, moving wildly, turning a blank space of concrete into a canvas. This is Hikari Wanda, a member of the hip-hop dance club. Kaboku is immediately smitten, but the road to stepping out of his shell is a long one. The club is almost entirely girls, and they're all, well, way better than him. What's ahead is unknown, and that's terrifying, but it also means, for the first time in Kaboku's life... a taste of freedom.

Naoya Kusaba is directing the film, with a script by Keiichi Kobayashi . Dancer and entrepreneur Charisma Kantarō is supervising the film's dances.

Runa Miura is supervising the dance of Kaboku Kotani (played by &TEAM boy band member JO ), KANU is in charge of Hikari Wanda (played by Anji Ikehata ), akihic☆彡 is in charge of On Miyao (played by Kira Yamaguchi ) and is also the choreographer for TEAM ON, and KEIN is in charge of Iori Itsukushima (played by Ran Mazzel). SEIYA is in charge of Usen Takumi (played by Aloha Takamatsu ) and is also the choreographer for the SAKAYA CREW.

title: 'Nabe ni Tama wo Ukenagara' Reveals Main Cast, Staff, Teaser Promo, Winter 2027 Premiere
content:
Production company Asmik Ace opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Juntarou Aoki and Shin Moriyama 's Nabe ni Tama wo Ukenagara ( Getting Shots on Frying Pan ) manga on Thursday, revealing the main cast, staff, and a teaser promotional video. Produced by J.C.Staff , the anime is scheduled to premiere on Nippon TV, Yomiuri TV, BS Nippon TV, and AT-X in January 2027.

Voice actors Shuu Uchida ( Yarinaoshi Reijou wa Ryuutei Heika wo Kouryakuchuu ) and Masaaki Mizunaka ( Nyaight of the Living Cat ) are voicing the beautiful girl and male versions of Juntarou Aoki, respectively.

Staff Director: Masahiro Hiraoka ( Kabushikigaisha Magi-Lumière ) Series Composition, Script: Susumu Yamakawa ( Maiko-san Chi no Makanai-san ) Character Design, Chief Animation Director: Natsuki Ooyama ( Danjo no Yuujou wa Seiritsu suru? (Iya, Shinai!!) ) Music: Yoshihide Ootomo ( Inu-Ou ) Sound Director: Yoshikazu Iwanami ( Kujima Utaeba Ie Hororo )

Aoki began serializing the slice of life manga, with illustrations by Moriyama, on Comic Newtype website in May 2021. Kadokawa published the fifth volume in October 2024.

A spin-off series titled Nabe ni Tama wo Ukenagara Transit featuring Hirota Takahara , began serializing on March 20.

Produced by J.C.Staff , the anime is scheduled to premiere on Nippon TV, Yomiuri TV, BS Nippon TV, and AT-X in January 2027.

Voice actors Shuu Uchida ( Yarinaoshi Reijou wa Ryuutei Heika wo Kouryakuchuu ) and Masaaki Mizunaka ( Nyaight of the Living Cat ) are voicing the beautiful girl and male versions of Juntarou Aoki, respectively.

Staff Director: Masahiro Hiraoka ( Kabushikigaisha Magi-Lumière ) Series Composition, Script: Susumu Yamakawa ( Maiko-san Chi no Makanai-san ) Character Design, Chief Animation Director: Natsuki Ooyama ( Danjo no Yuujou wa Seiritsu suru? (Iya, Shinai!!) ) Music: Yoshihide Ootomo ( Inu-Ou ) Sound Director: Yoshikazu Iwanami ( Kujima Utaeba Ie Hororo )
Aoki began serializing the slice of life manga, with illustrations by Moriyama, on Comic Newtype website in May 2021. Kadokawa published the fifth volume in October 2024.
A spin-off series titled Nabe ni Tama wo Ukenagara Transit featuring Hirota Takahara , began serializing on March 20.

title: Chained Soldier Manga Resumes on December 12
content:
This is a delay from the manga's originally planned resumption on November 14, but the announcement stated the new date was decided after taking Takemura's health into account.

The manga went on hiatus in October due to artist Takemura's poor health. Takemura stated in October they injured their right wrist in June, specifically damage to the fibrocartilage. Takemura added that they have been drawing while wearing a brace, but drawing places a heavy strain on their wrist, causing pain and impeding recovery. Takemura added that full recovery requires a long period of time, and they have decided to stop working on the manga's drafts to allow their wrist to heal.

Shonen Jump+ 's editorial staff stated in October that while the manga was scheduled to resume on November 14, Takemura's recovery is top priority. The staff added the manga's pace in the future will be determined in consultation with Takahiro and Takemura, and based on medical advice.

The battle fantasy is set in a world where a demonic gate has unleashed monsters known as Shūki. A special peach tree is able to give special powers, but only to women. The story begins when a down-on-his-luck boy named Yūki Wakura meets Uzen Kyōka, a girl who has gained the power of the peach, and is the captain of the 7th Anti-Demon Squad.

Takahiro ( Akame ga KILL! ) and Takemura ( Papa no Iu Koto o Kikinasai! manga) launched the manga on Shonen Jump+ manga website in January 2019. Yen Press publishes the manga in English.

The first season of the manga's anime adaptation premiered in Japan in January 2024. HIDIVE streamed the anime as it aired, and also streamed an English dub. The second season premiered on January 8. HIDIVE also streamed the second season as it aired, and also streamed an English dub. A third season is in the works.

title: Resident Evil Requiem Wins Golden Joystick Awards' Ultimate Game of the Year, Console Game of the Year
content:
The Golden Joystick 2026 ceremony announced this year's awards on Wednesday. CAPCOM 's Resident Evil Requiem game won the Ultimate Game of the Year award, as well as Console Game of the Year. Angela Sant'Albano also won Best Lead Performer for her performance as protagonist Grace Ashcroft in Resident Evil Reqiuem . The game's "Evil Has Always Had A Name" trailer also won the award for Best Game Trailer.

CAPCOM 's Onimusha: Way of the Sword won Best Audio Design.

Grace Saif won Best Supporting Performer for her performance as Diana in CAPCOM 's Pragmata .

CAPCOM won Studio of the Year.

Last year, Nintendo 's Donkey Kong Bananza won the Critics' Choice award. Niantic and Nintendo 's Pokémon GO won the Still Playing - Mobile award.

Since its inception in 1983, the Golden Joystick Awards select winners by votes cast by the public.
